name: SUBMET
summary: SUBMET is deployed on basement level 2 of the J-PARC Neutrino Monitor Building, Tokai. Although led by a Korean team, the detector is in Japan; its geography follows the apparatus site.
detection_principle: Small-charge particles produced by the J-PARC proton target traverse shielding and leave single-photoelectron-level coincidences in two layers of long scintillator bars pointing toward the target; beam timing gates suppress backgrounds.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
